# Refine an issue until it is ready

The rules are in the yardhand section of AGENTS.md (or CLAUDE.md). Read it first. When this repo has the CLI (`npx yardhand`, or `pnpm dlx yardhand` / `bunx yardhand`), use it for new IDs, status moves and front matter. Without it, follow the rules in that section exactly. That section also says what each status means; never move an issue into or out of a status that has no description unless asked.

1. Pick the issue (the one asked for, or the highest-priority one in `backlog`). Check it is at the right level. If it needs more than one model session, split it into children and refine those instead.
2. Write the H1 title, the Description (what and why), and the Acceptance criteria as checkboxes, one checkable outcome per line: `- [ ] ...`.
3. Set `size` with `npx yardhand set <id> --size small|medium|large`. If it is `large`, split it unless there is a good reason not to.
4. Set what applies: `--labels`, `--priority`, `--depends-on`, `--assignee`, and `--effort` when the assignee is a model.
5. Run `npx yardhand validate` and fix any errors.
6. Move it with `npx yardhand move <id> ready`. If this repo has no `ready` status, stop here and say so.

Do not write code.
